positions.name: AeroVironment
positions.catalyst: T1 POLICY: Trump proclamation (8/13) imposes 100% ad valorem tariff on drones >25kg or with thermal imaging plus docking/components, 25% on smaller drones, effective 9/3/26 - direct shield for US-based makers. Follows $400M US Army counter-drone laser award (8/7).
positions.risks: Already +35% in the past month; negative P/E (-35.7). Tariff is prospective (9/3) so the earnings benefit is distant. 8/13 range 185.68-194.20; mkt cap $11.7B.
positions.driver: Tier 1: drone tariff proclamation + Army contract

positions.name: Huntington Ingalls Industries
positions.catalyst: T1 POLICY: Presidential memo (8/13) 'Rebuilding the United States Navy and America's Shipbuilding Industrial Base' directs DoW to restore maritime industrial capacity. HII is the sole US builder of nuclear carriers/subs. Q2 EPS $5.27 on $3.42B rev beat; FY26 shipbuilding rev guide raised to $10.2-10.4B, margin 6.0-6.5%.
positions.risks: Memo explicitly allows near-term purchases from FOREIGN suppliers to restore competition - that cuts against HII's monopoly position and is the key two-way risk. Ex-div $1.38 on 8/28.
positions.driver: Tier 1: presidential shipbuilding memo + raised guide

positions.name: Tyson Foods
positions.catalyst: T1 RESTRUCTURING (8/13): closing Joslin IL beef plant (~2,500 jobs) and Eagle Mountain UT case-ready plant, selling Pasco WA, cutting Amarillo TX to one shift - consolidating beef into Amarillo/Dakota City/Holcomb to stem a beef segment loss running toward $650M in FY26. Shares +1.6% to 57.29 AH.
positions.risks: Cost cuts don't fix the underlying driver - US cattle supply is at a 60-year low. Restructuring charges likely. Thursday close 56.39 (+$0.58).

positions.name: Micron Technology
positions.catalyst: T1 NAMED PARTNERSHIP: Micron/Anthropic multi-year co-engineering and supply agreement covering HBM, data-center DRAM and SSDs; management guides 'very tight' memory conditions past 2027, with 2027 tighter than 2026. FQ3 rev $41.46B (+345.7% YoY) beat consensus $35.25B by 17.6%; non-GAAP EPS $25.11 vs $20.28. +3.0% pre-market to 1000.91 on 8/17.
positions.risks: Crossed $1T market cap and is up ~9x off the 52wk low of 113.46. PE 22 is not demanding, but the multiple assumes the memory cycle does not roll. The Anthropic deal is 3-4 sessions old, so the news edge is decaying - held intraday only for that reason.
positions.driver: Tier 1: Anthropic memory supply partnership + AI memory tightness

positions.name: Advanced Micro Devices
positions.catalyst: T1 FINANCING + CUSTOMER: AMD completed a record $4.75B bond sale on 8/14, read by the tape as AI capacity funding rather than balance-sheet stress, and BofA published a bullish long-term forecast. Anthropic has committed to up to 2 GW of MI450-series capacity. Q2 data-center rev doubled YoY to $6.7B; Q3 guide ~$13B (+41% YoY). Closed +6.5% at 514.39.
positions.risks: PE 132 is the richest multiple in the book. A debt-funded AI buildout cuts both ways if capex expectations reset. The 52wk high of 584.73 sits ~12% above spot, so there is real overhead supply.
positions.driver: Tier 1: record bond sale + BofA forecast + Anthropic 2GW commitment

positions.name: Nebius Group N.V.
positions.catalyst: T1 EARNINGS (8/14): Q2 rev $582.3M, +454% YoY; group adj EBITDA $236.2M at a 41% margin; core AI cloud +514% YoY; four cloud deals closed in the quarter each above $1B total contract value; 2026 outlook reaffirmed. Closed +8.9% at 277.68 and added another 1.7% pre-market Monday.
positions.risks: PE above 1,000 and a ~$70B market cap on $582M of quarterly revenue - the valuation is entirely forward-looking. Float is only 202M of 251M shares outstanding, so moves overshoot. The 52wk high of 299.86 is close overhead.

positions.name: Bristol Myers Squibb
positions.exitRule: Catalyst-defined: FDA action on the EXCALIBER-RRMM application - exit on the decision or by Wednesday's close, whichever comes first
positions.catalyst: T1 PDUFA TODAY (8/17): FDA target action date for iberdomide + daratumumab + dexamethasone versus daratumumab/bortezomib/dexamethasone in relapsed-refractory multiple myeloma (EXCALIBER-RRMM). A binary, calendar-dated regulatory decision.
positions.risks: PDUFA dates slip routinely, in which case this becomes dead money rather than a loss. BMY is a $130B mega-cap, so a single myeloma label is a modest revenue swing - expect a small percentage move in either direction. Trades near the 52wk high of 68.10 set 8/3.

positions.name: Eton Pharmaceuticals
positions.catalyst: T1 EARNINGS + REGULATORY (8/13-8/14): Q2 non-GAAP EPS $0.43 vs $0.19 consensus; rev $37.6M vs $27.1M est, +99% YoY on the Hemangeol relaunch. FY26 revenue guide raised to at least $145M from at least $120M. FDA Fast Track granted for AMGLIDIA; acquired US commercialization rights to orphan drug IMPAVIDO. H.C. Wainwright PT $70, Craig-Hallum $76. Closed +44%.

positions.name: Fabrinet
positions.exitRule: Catalyst-defined: FQ4 report after tonight's close - exit at Tuesday's open on the print
positions.catalyst: T1 EARNINGS TONIGHT (8/17 AMC): Fabrinet reports fiscal Q4 with consensus EPS of $3.79. As the contract optical-packaging manufacturer for the AI networking supply chain, this print is the cleanest available read on 800G/1.6T transceiver demand. +2.5% pre-market to 584.50.
positions.risks: This is a pre-print position - deliberate event risk with no directional edge. The stock is ~22% below its 52wk high of 748.89 (5/14), so the tape has already de-rated it once this year. Only 35.7M shares outstanding; post-earnings moves are violent.

positions.name: Home Depot
positions.exitRule: Catalyst-defined: Q2 report before the open Tuesday 8/18 - exit into the print at Tuesday's open

positions.name: Toll Brothers
positions.exitRule: Catalyst-defined: FQ3 report after the close Tuesday 8/18 - exit at Wednesday's open

positions.name: Analog Devices
positions.exitRule: Catalyst-defined: FQ3 report before the open Wednesday 8/19 - exit into the print
positions.catalyst: T1 EARNINGS (8/19 BMO): Analog Devices reports fiscal Q3 with consensus EPS of $3.33. The bellwether for analog/industrial semis - a sub-sector that has badly lagged the AI names - so a beat would broaden the semi rally beyond memory and GPUs. +1.2% pre-market to 394.00.
positions.risks: PE 58 on an industrial-cycle business is demanding. The 52wk high of 445.91 (6/22) is 13% overhead. Analog end markets (auto, industrial) are still working through a destocking hangover, so this is a genuine coin-flip.

positions.name: Lowe's Companies
